note: The SINGLE touch-target adjudication table (FASE F). The per-file census and its TOUCH_TARGET_EXEMPTIONS are retired; every row here is keyed to one physical box. CSS keys are `file :: rootScope :: finalPart`; TSX keys are `file :: element :: discriminator`. Both are matched against mechanical discovery — a key whose target disappears fails as stale, and a discovered target with neither a formal floor proof (equal / after-idiom / structural) nor a row here fails. `ancestor` is NOT a proof relation: a floored container never establishes a child hitbox. Debt rows carry an owner and drain decrease-only (D1-floors).
